sources.title: Mobile-VIT - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Mobile-VIT Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone. MobileVit is a machine learning model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset. It can also be used as a backbone in building more complex models for specific use cases.
